_note: The early-access banner and the Early Beta badge (prompts 82-83). endsAt is when the badge stops being given and the banner goes: change it (and launchLabel) if launch day moves. Wording and the badge approved by Nav on 2026-11-25 (prompt 84).
title: Early access
short: Progress resets at launch on 15 Dec.
body: OneSmallClick is still being built, so progress may be reset along the way while I work on it.
Launch is planned for 15 December, though the date may move. On launch day the probe starts again from Earth and every reward earned so far is reset.
Sign in before then and you'll get the Early Beta badge, which you keep for good.
OneSmallClick is a side project made by one person, so thank you for taking part this early.
haveBadge: You have the Early Beta badge. Thank you for being here early.
badgeHowGuest: Sign in before 15 Dec to get it
